profile_text.body:
NXAI is a frontier AI lab founded in 2023 and headquartered in Linz, Austria. The company describes itself as building systems that master any cognitive task, with a focus on proprietary xLSTM memory architectures that it claims outperform Transformers. Chief Scientist and co-founder Prof. Dr. Sepp Hochreiter is identified as one of the fathers of modern deep learning. NXAI works closely with JKU Linz and other research institutions.

The company's core product is its xLSTM architecture, which it describes as enabling state-tracking capabilities. NXAI is currently building specialized world models based on time-series analysis under the name TiRex, deployed in edge, embedded, and forecasting applications. The company claims its xLSTM models deliver 50× impact across industrial systems. Looking forward, NXAI states it will develop large-scale world models built on neural memory hierarchies and memory routing with applications in robotics.

NXAI emphasizes performance and efficiency as driving forces behind its models. While the company deploys xLSTM models in cloud environments, it focuses on edge applications and operates its own edge lab. According to its website, the architecture is designed for versatility across time series, natural language, robotics, and biosciences applications, claiming to deliver higher accuracy, faster inference, and lower operational costs.
